# RUN_MATRIX (generated by `run_matrix.py` - do not hand-edit)

Budget plan for the TokaMark `task_1-3` study: 3 models x 3 variants (plain / mask / mask+PINN) x seeds, random split main table, temporal replica, robustness passes, one `tune` stage per model.

## 1. Inputs and how trustworthy each is

| Quantity | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| CNN+MLP plain, 1 run | 2.58 h | **measured** (user brief, 155 min) |
| CNN+MLP mask+PINN, 1 run | 3.17 h | **measured** (190 min; `train_summary.json` says 194.4 min, 4,200 steps, 53 epochs) |
| CNN+LSTM mask+PINN, 1 run | 3.17 h | **measured** (user brief, ~190 min) |
| CNN+LSTM plain | 2.6 h | extrapolated (LSTM x 155/190) |
| mask-only (MLP, LSTM) | 3.0 h | assumed |
| Transformer plain / mask / mask+PINN | 3.4 / 3.9 / 4.1 h | **extrapolated 1.3 x CNN+LSTM, no measurement; +/-50 %** |
| post-train eval + plots per run | 0.25 h | assumed |
| robustness study, 63 passes | 1.5 h | user brief (1-2 h), midpoint; an older log in `results/robustness_lstm` shows 8.7 min for a smaller harness, so this is conservative |
| `tune` per model | 6 trials x 0.25 h = 1.5 h | derived from the in-progress `tune` defaults (6 trials x 300 steps) at the measured step time; confirm with the first tune run |
| 1 or 2 GPUs | 1 T4 == 2xT4 | the 190-min run logged `single GPU (DataParallel not clearly faster)`, so durations are 1-T4 durations |
| Kaggle | 2 accounts x 30 h/week, sessions packed to 9 h | user brief; session limit 9-12 h unverified, 9 used |
| Kaggle per-session overhead | 0.4 h with a saved dataset / 2.0 h re-downloading ~40 GB | assumed / notebook default `TM_PREP_DEADLINE_H=2.0` |

### Modal price (list, USD) - https://modal.com/pricing, fetched 2026-11-04

| GPU | $/s | $/h GPU only | $/h all-in (4 cores + 16 GiB) |
|---|---|---|---|
| T4 | 0.000164 | 0.590 | 0.907 |
| L4 | 0.000222 | 0.799 | 1.116 |
| A10G | 0.000306 | 1.102 | 1.418 |
| L40S | 0.000542 | 1.951 | 2.268 |
| A100_40 | 0.000583 | 2.099 | 2.415 |
| A100_80 | 0.000694 | 2.498 | 2.815 |
| H100 | 0.001097 | 3.949 | 4.266 |

CPU $1.31e-05/physical core/s, memory $2.22e-06/GiB/s. CPU-only prep container: $0.317/h. Starter plan advertises $30/month free credit.

**What does "20 hrs" mean?** Modal bills dollars, not hours.

- Interpretation A, $20 credit: 22.1 T4-hours all-in (33.9 h if only the GPU were billed; CPU and memory are billed on top), 17.9 L4-h, 14.1 A10G-h, 8.3 A100-40GB-h.
- Interpretation B, 20 literal hours: ~20 T4-h (about $18). Same order of magnitude, so the plan below is insensitive to the reading.
- Check the real balance in the Modal dashboard (Settings -> Billing) before the first real job; this repo cannot read it.

**Is a faster Modal GPU worth it?** L4 is cheaper per run than T4 only if it is > 1.23x faster (all-in), A10G if > 1.56x. The job may be input-bound (DataParallel did not help), in which case a bigger GPU buys nothing: measure steps/s in the smoke test on T4 and L4 and pick by that rule. Plan assumes T4.

## 2. Scenarios

| Scenario | train runs | rob passes | total GPU-h | +10 % early-stop contingency | Kaggle A h / weeks | Kaggle B h / weeks | Modal h / cost | weeks if data NOT saved as dataset |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **minimal** | 13 | 3 | 50.4 | 55.5 | 16.8 / 1 | 18.9 / 1 | 14.8 / $14.4 | A 1, B 1 |
| **target** | 33 | 9 | 132.0 | 145.2 | 57.8 / 3 | 57.8 / 3 | 16.4 / $16.8 | A 3, B 3 |
| **stretch** | 54 | 15 | 214.0 | 235.4 | 98.0 / 4 | 99.4 / 4 | 16.6 / $16.9 | A 5, B 5 |

Weeks = ceil(session wall-hours / 30) per account, sessions first-fit packed to 9 h. If 2 independent processes (one per T4) fit in one 2xT4 session without slowing down (untested; DataParallel not helping hints at an input bottleneck, so test it with the first real session), Kaggle weeks roughly halve. Modal capacity above is 16.7 T4-h after CPU-only prep, one smoke test and a 15% credit reserve (interpretation A).

Scenario content:

- **minimal**: half-size tune; the 9 ablation cells x seed 1 (random); seeds 2-3 for CNN+MLP plain and mask+PINN only (a mean +/- std on the headline pair); robustness for the three mask+PINN models.
- **target**: full tune; all 9 cells x seeds 1-3 (27 runs); robustness for all 9 cells (seed 1); temporal replica of plain and mask+PINN for each model (6 runs).
- **stretch**: target + seeds 4-5 for every cell (18 runs), temporal mask rows (3), temporal robustness (6).

## 3. Priority order and cut order

Run in tier order; the ablation table is fillable (one seed, every cell) as soon as tier 2 finishes. Cut from the bottom when hours run out.

| Tier | Content | If hours run out |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `prep` random (once), smoke test | never cut |
| 1 | `tune` per model | shrink trials, never skip: equal tuning is a stated requirement |
| 2 | 9 cells x seed 1 (random) | last to cut; order cnn_mlp, cnn_lstm, transformer |
| 3 | robustness: mask+PINN and plain, seed 1 | cut plain before mask+PINN |
| 4 | seeds 2-3, all cells | keep headline pair (cnn_mlp plain / mask+PINN) longest; drop transformer seeds first (most expensive, least certain) |
| 5 | temporal replica + robustness of mask rows | drop mask robustness first, then temporal transformer |
| 6 | seeds 4-5, temporal mask, temporal robustness | cut first |

## 4. Data: keeping every seed and variant on the SAME shots

`out/<split>/selection.json` (plus `out/tar_index.json`, which makes `prep` skip re-indexing) is the contract. Existing local copy: `cnn_mlp/results/run_40gb_CNN_MLP_failure_aware/out/random/selection.json` (606/74/60 shots, 40 GB). **Reuse it instead of re-selecting**: upload it to the Modal data volume (`RUNBOOK_MODAL.md` step 3), so Modal downloads exactly those shots, and copy the same file into every Kaggle notebook (it is 0.3 MB; `prep` reuses it when it has >=5 shots per subset and `TM_FORCE_RESELECT` is unset).

| Option | Per-session cost | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Kaggle re-downloads from HF every session | ~2.0 h GPU quota each (notebook default prep deadline 2 h) | target plan = 16 sessions -> ~32 quota-hours burned on downloading: avoid |
| **Tar each split once on Modal, download, upload as a Kaggle dataset (recommended for Kaggle)** | ~0.4 h (untar to local disk) | one-time: `modal volume get tokamark-data tars/random.tar .` then upload (40 GB; Kaggle private dataset limits not verified - check before relying; a tar is 1 file, so file-count limits are not an issue). Put the same selection.json inside. |
| Run everything on Modal | 0 h (volume -> local disk untar ~minutes) | limited by ~20 h credit, so Modal alone covers only ~6 full runs |
Recommendation: prep once on Modal (CPU-only, ~$1), keep Modal as the source of truth, and ship the tar + selection.json to a Kaggle dataset if the upload bandwidth allows; otherwise accept one HF re-download per Kaggle session and use long (11-12 h) sessions to amortise it. Temporal split is a separate 40 GB (different official shot lists) - only needed in tier 5+; keep it on Modal.

## 6. Notes

- Robustness jobs run in the same bin as their training job because they need that run's `best_model.pt` (Kaggle: same session or saved output; Modal: same results volume).
- Transformer figures are the weakest numbers here. If the first transformer smoke test shows step time k x the LSTM's, scale `TRAIN_H` in `run_matrix.py` and re-run.
- Kaggle bins are balanced by hours, not by model, so any model can land on either account; `selection.json` identity matters, not the account.
